# P27 (process)
# generated by gen_views.py; sources: elements.jsonl 95570c1f441443df

Before any loss, the room chooses where to put its work and changes the spot while it builds. It looks for open room, weighs a crowded or contested place, shrinks or moves the design ahead of a neighbour or the void, restarts a misplaced start, and refuses to move once enough pixels are in.
